plan.title: Comprehensive Quantitative Aptitude & Arithmetic Study Plan
plan.summary: A 4-week intensive schedule restructured to cover all major quantitative aptitude and arithmetic concepts for competitive exams, maintaining daily 2-hour evening study sessions.

weeks.milestone: Master percentages, ratios, averages, and number system basics.

tasks.activity: 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Learn fraction-to-percentage shortcuts and solve 20 basic problems.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Study ratio properties and solve 15 fundamental questions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Practice 25 questions on weighted averages and grouping.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Practice BODMAS rules and approximation techniques.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Revise divisibility rules and unit digit concepts.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Solve 20 problems on co-prime numbers and word problems.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Study markup, discount, and successive percentage concepts.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Solve 20 advanced percentage word problems.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Review week's formula notes and shortcut tricks.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Learn SI/CI difference formulas and solve 15 problems.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Solve coin and income-expenditure based questions.
7:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Take a full quantitative aptitude sectional test and analyze errors.

weeks.milestone: Master time & work, speed, distance, and basic DI sets.

tasks.activity: 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Learn efficiency methods and solve 20 multi-person problems.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Practice inlet/outlet pipe efficiency questions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Practice relative speed and train crossing problems.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Solve upstream and downstream conceptual questions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Learn replacement and concentration concepts.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Solve profit-sharing ratio problems.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Practice tabular and bar chart DI sets.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Timed drill of 25 mixed arithmetic questions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Quick review of time, speed, and work formulas.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Solve 25 comparison inequalities and root finding.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Practice missing and wrong number series patterns.
7:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Take a comprehensive quant mock test under strict timing.

weeks.milestone: Cover algebra, advanced math topics, and heavy DI practice.

tasks.activity: 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Practice algebraic identities and polynomial equations.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Revise triangles, circles, and polygon properties.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Solve 2D and 3D area/volume problems.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Practice height and distance fundamental questions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Practice pie chart and caselet DI sets.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Solve basic permutation, combination, and probability sums.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Timed drill of 40 mixed arithmetic and calculation problems.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Review tough previous year algebra and geometry questions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Review advanced math formula sheets and shortcut tricks.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Practice multiplication shortcuts, squares, and cubes.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Solve 3 DI sets and 20 simplification questions.
7:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Take a timed quant mock and review weak spots.

weeks.milestone: Simulate real exam pressure and solidify all arithmetic and quant concepts.

tasks.activity: 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Rapid review of percentages, profit/loss, and time/work.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Review algebra, geometry, and number system shortcuts.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Solve 30 mixed quantitative aptitude questions.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Go through previous mock mistakes and clear doubts.
7:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Take a full-length quantitative aptitude mock exam.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Deep dive into mock errors and recalculate tricky questions.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Final read-through of all arithmetic and advanced formulas.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Relaxed review of formula summary sheets before exam day.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Final calm-down review of key calculation shortcuts.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Review exam performance and plan further practice steps.

tips: Focus heavily on mastering arithmetic fundamentals like percentages and ratios first.
Maintain your 7:30 PM - 9:30 PM daily study block to build calculation speed and consistency.
Analyze every mock test thoroughly to eliminate recurring calculation errors.

form.goal: I'm preparing for all government exams so plan a proper schedule to cover all
